voice.text: This sign once said HOLLYWOODLAND. So why did four letters vanish? It began in 1923 as an advert for a housing estate. It was meant to stand for just eighteen months. In 1949 the city agreed to repair it, if LAND came down. Turns out, a billboard for houses became the name of an industry. Send this to someone who thinks it was always like this. Not how you picture it, number four.

caption:
NOT HOW YOU PICTURE IT · Nº 4 🎬 Hollywood sign HOLLYWOODLAND history: the famous sign once spelled HOLLYWOODLAND.

It went up in 1923 as an advert for a housing estate, and was meant to stand for only about eighteen months. In 1949 the Hollywood Chamber of Commerce agreed to rebuild it on one condition: the city would drop LAND, so the sign named the district and not the houses.

Send this to someone who thinks it was always like this.
